【瀋陽站、瀋陽北站多趟列車臨時停運】受持續降雨影響，遼寧瀋陽站、瀋陽北站部分列車停運。為確保鐵路運輸和旅客出行安全，國鐵瀋陽局及時啟動防颱防汛應急響應，對京通、錦承、沈吉、長圖、梅集、渾白、沈山等線路普速列車，以及京哈、沈丹、新通、長琿、沈白、沈大、朝凌、盤營等線路部分割槽段高鐵列車，採取臨時停運措施。
【Shein執行長徐仰天將在香港IPO前出任董事長一職】一位直接瞭解情況的訊息人士週一表示，隨著快時尚零售商Shein準備在香港進行備受期待的首次公開募股（IPO），該公司執行長徐仰天將出任董事長一職，而Donald Tang則將從執行董事長轉任高階顧問。
【阿曼附近海域一油輪遭襲】英國海上貿易行動辦公室13日釋出通報說，一艘油輪當天在阿曼附近海域遭不明發射物擊中，目前船員安全。 通報說，事件發生在阿曼蓋勒哈特東北約40海里處，事件報告時間為協調世界時13日21時04分（北京時間14日5時04分）。 通報援引該油輪船長報告內容稱，船舶機艙右舷部位遭一枚不明發射物擊中。所有船員均安全，未報告發生環境汙染。(新華社)
【滬市公司近期將派發約2600億“現金紅包” 高股息陣營彰顯核心配置價值】統計資料顯示，截至7月13日，滬市上市公司2025年年報現金分紅已完成派發超過8900億元，剩餘約2600億元分紅資金將在近期密集落地。整體上，當前滬市年報分紅落地節奏清晰、規模可觀，以上證50指數、上證180指數成份股為代表的核心藍籌板塊股息表現亮眼，高股息陣營正成為支撐市場穩健配置的重要基石。（上海證券報）
【國家防辦向吉林緊急調撥中央防汛物資，支援做好防汛搶險工作】7月13日，應吉林省防汛抗旱指揮部請求，國家防辦會同國家糧食和儲備局緊急調撥編織袋、復膜編織布、長絲土工布、網箱網兜、照明裝置等4300餘件中央防汛物資，支援吉林做好防汛搶險工作。

【駐沙特大使館提醒在沙中國公民和機構注意人身和財產安全】據“中國駐沙特大使館”公眾號訊息，7月13日晚，沙特官方釋出訊息稱，在南部地區攔截了導彈，沙特部分機場航班受到影響。為確保在沙中國公民和機構的人身財產安全，中國駐沙特使館就有關事項提醒如下：一、保持冷靜心態，密切關注沙特官方釋出的安全提示和中國駐沙使領館領事提醒，按照當地政府、應急部門等機構的資訊通報，沉著應對。二、請在沙中國公民減少非必要出行和跨區域流動，密切關注周邊環境和安全形勢，遠離當地的軍事設施及敏感區域。如遇緊急情況，請立即前往最近的堅固建築內避險，遠離門窗、陽臺及空曠地帶，切勿在外逗留或聚集觀望，勿拍攝涉軍事行動的影像。三、近期有乘飛機安排的中國公民，出行前務必透過航司官網、購票平臺、機場官方平臺等渠道，持續關注航班最新動態，並根據實時資訊審慎評估並妥善安排或調整行程。切勿輕信社交媒體等非官方渠道釋出的航空資訊，警惕各類虛假資訊和電信詐騙，以免遭受不必要的人身財產損失。四、如遇不測事件，請在確保自身安全的前提下第一時間報警，並聯系中國駐沙特使館、駐吉達總領館尋求協助。沙特當地應急電話：報警999；交通意外993；救護車997；火警998。外交部全球領事保護與服務應急熱線（24小時）：+86-10-12308、+86-10-65612308。駐沙特使館領事保護協助電話：+966-11-4831590；駐吉達總領館領事保護協助電話：+966-508399809

UK Retail Sales Growth Softens in June — UK retail sales rose by 1.7% year-on-year on a like-for-like basis in June 2026, falling short of market expectations for a 2.9% gain, slowing from a 3.4% increase in May and marking the softest growth since February. Despite the slowdown, spending was supported by the men's FIFA World Cup and a prolonged heatwave, which boosted demand for clothing, electric fans, air-conditioning units, food and beverages, while pubs benefited from increased trade during England's matchdays. Online sales also remained resilient as soaring temperatures discouraged shoppers from visiting physical stores. Retailers noted that promotions helped support demand, particularly for home electronics and seasonal goods. Looking ahead, the British Retail Consortium warned that political uncertainty and the potential impact of the conflict in the Middle East on food prices could weigh on consumer confidence and retail spending in the coming months.

【人民日報鐘聲：南海不是“遊獵園”，更非“角鬥場”】南海不是域外國家的“遊獵園”，更不應成為大國博弈的“角鬥場”。美國、日本、澳大利亞等國以及歐盟並非南海問題當事方，本應對南海主權爭議秉持客觀中立立場，卻出於地緣戰略私利，一再為非法無效的所謂“裁決”站臺背書。 南海的和平穩定與繁榮發展，只能由地區國家自己主導、自己守護，不需要也絕不接受任何域外勢力的干涉與破壞。奉勸有關域外國家認清大勢，立即停止在南海興風作浪。個別地區國家也應認清域外勢力的險惡用心，盡快回到當事國協商處理海上爭議，遵守和落實《宣言》的正確軌道上來。

【美軍稱開始對伊朗發動連續第三晚打擊】美軍中央司令部13日在社交媒體發文說，美國東部時間當天16時45分，美軍開始對伊朗發動“連續第三晚”的打擊行動。 美軍中央司令部稱，這些打擊將繼續使伊朗軍隊付出沉重代價，並削弱其在霍爾木茲海峽襲擊商船的能力。 當天稍早時，美國總統特朗普在接受美國一電臺主持人採訪時說：“今晚我們會狠打他們，明天也會狠狠打他們。”他還稱美伊達成的諒解備忘錄只是一個“測試”，本身就沒有多大約束力，而伊朗“沒能經受住這次測試”。（新華社）
【美聯儲維持100億美元國庫券購買規模不變】美聯儲週一表示，本週期將購買約100億美元國庫券，規模與此前兩個操作週期持平。目前政策制定者試圖充實銀行準備金，以應對未來幾個月可能出現的資金流失。網站資訊顯示，紐約聯儲公開市場交易部門計劃在截至8月13日的月度操作週期執行上述儲備購買管理，並且還計劃開展約176億美元的再投資操作。

【險資年內密集參設股權投資基金，佈局AI、半導體等領域】7月10日，中國人壽釋出公告稱，其擬與國壽產業投資管理有限公司訂立合夥協議，成立天津晟和芯程股權投資基金合夥企業（有限合夥）。該合夥企業全體合夥人認繳出資總額為50億元，合夥企業將重點投資於半導體行業公司。這是年內險資積極參設股權投資基金的一個縮影。據統計，今年以來，已有超10家保險機構參與設立多隻股權投資基金，基金投資方向包括AI（人工智慧）和半導體等新興科技領域。受訪專家認為，年內險資密集參設股權投資基金，主要受提升長期回報、政策引導、平滑報表波動等因素影響。（證券日報）
【國泰海通：美伊衝突升級擾動油價 預計7月中下旬將陸續迎來流動性壓力的緩和】國泰海通釋出研報稱，中東局勢再次升級下油價有所回升，美聯儲表態趨鷹但內部分歧仍大。若後續通脹壓力如期回落且7月FOMC會議未釋放更多的鷹派訊號，則有望看到加息擔憂的進一步降溫。預計7月中下旬將陸續迎來流動性壓力的緩和，從“黑色六月”進入“反轉七月”。
【美軍稱首次實戰中使用海上無人艇】美軍中央司令部7月13日在社交媒體發影片及帖文稱，當天凌晨，美軍動用海上無人艇打擊伊朗。這是美軍首次在實戰中動用海上無人艇。美軍中央司令部在帖文中稱，美軍使用多艘“單向攻擊水面無人艇”，“成功打擊伊朗一處潛艇和艦船維修設施”，3艘“海盜”水面無人艇擊中伊朗阿巴斯港海軍基地的港口。(CCTV國際時訊)

【紅杉資本前掌門人羅洛夫·博塔在任職逾20年後離職】紅杉資本(Sequoia Capital)前負責人羅洛夫.博塔(Roelof Botha)表示他已離開該公司，八個月前，Alfred Lin和帕特·格雷迪(Pat Grady)接替他出任該公司的最高職位。博塔在釋出於領英(LinkedIn)的一篇帖子中表示，鑑於他需要將大量時間投入到各項董事會職務和個人投資上，他已離開紅杉資本。他上個月加入了SpaceX的董事會，並在其他幾家公司擔任董事，包括支付公司Block、保險科技公司Ethos和文件資料庫公司MongoDB。他還表示，自己正與“幾家新興未上市企業”的創始人密切合作。博塔在帖子中寫道：“我對自己接下來的道路充滿期待，因為我始終熱衷於支援創始人打造定義品類的公司。”
【阿聯酋兩艘油輪在霍爾木茲海峽遭巡航導彈襲擊 】據阿聯酋通訊社14日報道，阿聯酋國防部說，兩艘阿聯酋國家油輪當天在霍爾木茲海峽南部航道遭兩枚來自伊朗方向的巡航導彈襲擊。（新華社）

【胡塞武裝向沙特發射導彈 打破持續四年停戰局面】葉門胡塞運動週一指責沙烏地阿拉伯轟炸其控制的一座機場後，向沙特發射導彈，打破沙特與該親伊朗組織之間持續四年的停戰局面。沙特領導的葉門軍事聯盟發言人週一在X平臺表示，沙特已攔截“由恐怖組織胡塞民兵向南部地區發射的導彈”。胡塞武裝軍事發言人Yahya Saree表示，他們鎖定的目標是沙特阿布哈市(Abha)的國際機場。阿布哈是與葉門接壤南部山區地區的首府，許多沙特人常在此避暑。這是自2022年3月非正式停火生效以來，胡塞武裝首次宣稱對沙特發動攻擊。當年的停戰是在胡塞襲擊沙國能源基礎設施後達成的。週一的暴力事件使沙國南部邊境面臨衝突再起的風險。此前，隨著4月伊朗衝突停火協議的達成，針對沙特東部地區和利雅得的伊朗無人機及導彈襲擊已逐漸平息。

【UK retail sales rose in June despite heatwave】British Retail Consortium and KPMG report: UK retail sales rose 1.9% YoY over the five weeks to July 4 (May 31–July 4) despite record high temperatures and the World Cup. BRC said store sales were dampened by the heat but timely promotions pushed online share to its highest level in 2026. Strong demand for fans and air conditioners and World Cup-driven gains in consumer electronics and food & drink supported the increase. Report warns political uncertainty and the Middle East war may further weaken consumer confidence.

【住房租賃市場季節性回暖，一線城市修復訊號最為明顯】受高校畢業季等因素影響，6月份住房租賃需求集中釋放，帶動住房租賃市場季節性回暖。中指研究院資料顯示，6月份，50城住宅平均租金為33.97元/平方米/月，環比漲幅為0.08%，結束了連續兩個月的小幅調整；同比下跌2.82%，跌幅較5月份收窄0.35個百分點。“經歷過去幾年的價格調整，重點城市租金底部支撐逐步夯實，市場修復彈性有所增強。”中指研究院指數研究部總經理曹晶晶表示，6月份各梯隊城市租金環比表現有所改善，其中一線城市修復訊號最為明顯，住宅租金築底態勢逐步顯現。（證券日報）

New Zealand Stocks Edge Lower in Morning Trade — The NZX 50 fell 20 points, or 0.2%, to 13,703 in Tuesday morning trade, reversing gains from the previous session, mainly weighed down by losses in the financial, communication services, technology, and utilities sectors. Rising oil prices due to the escalating conflict in the Middle East continued to pressure sentiment as inflation concerns fueled expectations of further interest rate hikes. Investors also awaited the release of US inflation data, along with key Chinese economic data, including Q2 GDP, due later this week. However, Monday's data helped limit the decline as New Zealand's private sector recorded its strongest growth since December 2025. On the data front, New Zealand's visitor arrivals rose 6.7% in May after rising 8% in April, marking the slowest growth in four months. Infratil shed 1.9%, A2 Milk dropped 1.8%, Ebos Group fell 1.7%, and Henderson Far East Income declined 0.6%.

【7月14日美股成交額前20：SK海力士股價大跌9.3%】週一美股成交額第11名SK海力士（SKHY）收跌9.32%，成交87.79億美元。分析師指出，SK海力士股價暴跌是多重因素疊加導致的短期市場調整。直接導火索是韓國投資證券釋出的業績預測顯示，公司第二季度營業利潤預期較市場共識低約8%，引發投資者擔憂。更深層的原因在於，SK海力士HBM產品採用長期協議定價，無法與通用DRAM同步漲價，導致其短期盈利增長不及市場預期。同時，HBM4在二季度出貨未能如期放量，加上公司赴美上市前股價已累計上漲約630%，利好兌現後投資者獲利了結情緒濃厚。儘管韓國央行和公司管理層強調晶片超級週期仍在持續，但市場對儲存晶片週期屬性的擔憂、估值高位以及對AI投資回報的質疑，共同觸發了此次回撥。

Uruguay Industrial Production Contracts in May — Uruguay's industrial production fell 3.5% year-on-year in May 2026 after rising 4.0% in the previous month, marking the sharpest decline since October 2025. The contraction was driven primarily by a 4.5% drop in food manufacturing. Other major drags included motor vehicle manufacturing, which fell 41.2%, and chemicals production, down 12.2%. On the upside, paper manufacturing rose 15.0%, beverage production increased 16.9%, and electrical equipment manufacturing climbed 29.1%. Hours worked in the industrial sector declined 6.1% from a year earlier. Industrial employment also weakened, with the occupied personnel index falling 2.1% year-on-year.

【Waller: Fed should avoid premature hikes that trigger recession, but not repeat past delays】Federal Reserve Governor Waller said he does not want premature rate hikes that could trigger a recession, but warned the Fed should avoid repeating the mistake of delaying action while price pressures rise. He said the labor market is far less overheated than during the 2022–23 tightening and there are credible reasons to expect inflation to continue falling without additional tightening, but evidence that firms and investors expect that decline is insufficient to justify waiting. Waller warned that if the Fed waits until confidence fades it will have to raise rates more aggressively and said the central bank cannot afford to ignore inflation until it disappears.

【Waller: Tuesday CPI will decide next move; hot inflation could prompt near-term hikes】Federal Reserve Governor Waller said Tuesday's CPI and incoming data will determine policy direction, warning that if inflation remains well above the 2% target the Fed may need to raise rates in the short term. He described policy as at a crossroads and expressed concern recent reports show price pressures broadening beyond tariffs and energy — potentially signaling more entrenched, systemic inflation that would require tighter policy. If core CPI prints hot again this week, the FOMC would have to consider near-term tightening; Waller said it would take months of sustained declines in inflation data to be confident the trend is moving toward 2%.

【Iran says southern Strait of Hormuz lane 'unsafe'】Iran's embassy in the UK said on the 13th on social media that the southern navigation lane of the Strait of Hormuz is "unsafe, unreliable and prone to accidents." The embassy, noting Iran's ambassador to the UK also serves as its permanent representative to the IMO, said Iran has set up a temporary maritime security corridor to comply with an Islamabad MoU, that corridor has no technical or military barriers and has been notified to the IMO. It accused the United States of directing ships onto a dangerous southern parallel route whose legality is doubtful and which is unsafe, and said US attacks on Iranian ports and other "acts of military aggression" have made the Strait a highly tense, high-risk area.

Heating Oil Rises to Nearly 6-Week High — Heating oil in the US rose nearly 6% to $3.76 per gallon, the highest since June 3, as concerns over fuel supplies increased. President Donald Trump said the US would reinstate a naval blockade on Iran and impose a 20% reimbursement fee on cargo passing through the Strait of Hormuz, raising fears over disruptions to regional energy flows. Supply concerns were also heightened by disruptions to Russian energy exports, with Ukraine reporting strikes on an oil depot in Stavropol and storage facilities at the port of Kavkaz. Russia said it would suspend diesel exports and become a net importer as repeated Ukrainian attacks and higher crude prices disrupted operations at key refineries. Meanwhile, Kazakhstan’s Caspian Pipeline Consortium reduced shipments by 7% in June due to maintenance at the Tengiz oilfield and lower Russian flows. At the same time, warmer-than-normal weather forecasts through July 28 are also expected to keep power sector fuel demand elevated.

Tenaris followed with a 1.7% gain, while utility stocks also advanced as higher temperatures increase electricity demand for cooling. Stellantis added 2.6% on reports of stronger growth in North America, its most important market. Inwit rose 2.2% after a Milan court suspended TIM's withdrawal from their MSA. European Stocks Inch Marginally Lower — Pan-European stock indices closed marginally lower on Monday as the escalation to the war in the Middle East continued to cloud the macroeconomic backdrop for energy importers. The Euro STOXX 50 inched 0.1% down to 6,264 and the STOXX Europe 600 inched 0.1% down to 641. Sovereign yields rose together with energy prices after the US and Iran threatened to restore blockades on vessels leaving the Strait of Hormuz. Banks dropped from the tighter credit conditions, with Santander and Deutsche Bank down more than 1% each. Also, ASML lost 1.8% and Infineon dropped close to 3%, tracking losses for US and Asian counterparts after brokers noted that SK Hynix may miss its earnings guidance. In turn, the traction in oil prices aided energy producers with TotalEnergies and ENI gaining 3% and 4%, respectively.

CAC 40 Rises as Energy Stocks Rally — The CAC 40 gained 0.3% to close at 8,365 on Monday, lifted by gains in the energy and luxury sectors. TotalEnergies advanced 3% as oil prices surged following a fresh wave of US strikes on Iran and conflicting statements from Washington and Tehran over the status of the Strait of Hormuz. Luxury stocks also traded higher, with Hermes up 0.9% and Kering adding 0.7%. Stellantis gained 1.8% after reporting that preliminary second-quarter vehicle shipments rose 10% year-on-year to nearly 1.6 million units, driven by strong growth in North America, its largest market. In contrast, heavyweight industrial stocks posted losses as Middle East tensions heightened market uncertainty. The spike in energy prices reignited inflation concerns, prompting markets to price in two additional ECB interest rate hikes over the next year, with the first expected in September. Airbus lost 1%, while Safran shed 1.8%.

FTSE 100 Supported by Oil Companies — The FTSE 100 was little changed on Monday as strength in energy stocks and homebuilders offset broad market weakness. Oil companies supported the index after President Donald Trump said the US would reimpose a blockade on Iran and proposed a 20% fee on cargo passing through the Strait of Hormuz, raising concerns over renewed geopolitical risks. Shell gained 2.3% and BP advanced 4.2%. Shell also announced the sale of its Indian renewable energy business, Sprng Energy, to Aditya Birla for $1.8 billion as part of its strategy to refocus on oil and gas assets. Homebuilders also benefited from reports that Andy Burnham could revive a government-backed housing support scheme, with Persimmon rising 2.6% and Barratt Redrow up 1.5%. On the other hand, mining shares were among the biggest decliners, with Fresnillo and Endeavour both down around 2.6%, while banks and pharmaceutical stocks also came under pressure.

【華爾街大行將密集釋出財報 瑞銀料高盛財報與摩根大通接班人將成焦點】瑞銀分析師Erika Najarian表示，高盛在本輪財報中面臨最大的考驗，要在華爾街各大銀行中脫穎而出並不容易；與此同時，投資者正聚焦誰可能接替傑米·戴蒙出任摩根大通執行長。Najarian週一表示，“考慮到市場預期和投資者持倉，高盛面臨的考驗最大。”Najarian說，美國六大銀行中有五家將於週二公佈業績，“想要脫穎而出並不容易，尤其是我預計摩根大通的財報電話會很大程度上將圍繞接班人問題展開。”Najarian是瑞銀負責大型銀行和消費金融板塊的股票研究分析師。本週，美國市值合計超過2萬億美元的大型銀行將密集釋出財報。高盛、摩根大通、美國銀行、富國和花旗集團將於週二公佈業績，摩根士丹利則於週三釋出。相比這些行業龍頭通常為期三天的財報釋出節奏，今年時間安排更為集中。
